name: property-merge-with-unset
body: `update --property` semantics are MERGE: set/overwrite only the keys passed, preserve all other existing keys. Deleting a key requires the new explicit `--unset-property k` flag; there is NO implicit unset. This applies to both `apg node update` and `apg edge update`. Acceptance: `update --property a=1` on a node with `{a:0,b:2}` yields `{a:1,b:2}`; `update --unset-property b` yields `{a:1}`; omitting `--unset-property` never removes a key.
